description: Updates an existing notification channel. Only what you pass changes: name, isDefault and each field in config are merged onto the stored channel, so a rename keeps the credentials. A secret sent back as "***" keeps its stored value. Changing type discards the stored config, so pass the new type's full config with it. Find the ID with listNotifications; to add a channel use createNotification, and to remove one, deleteNotification.

applyExisting.description: Attach this channel to every existing monitor now. One-off: it is not stored.

config.description: Type-specific configuration fields to change. Fields left out keep their stored value, unless type changes.

isDefault.description: Enable by default for new monitors. Omit to keep the current value.

name.description: New human-readable name. Omit to keep the current one.

notificationID.description: The ID of the notification to update

type.description: New notification type. Omit to keep the current one. A different type discards the stored config.

name: updateNotification
title: Update Notification
